dt_job_lot_slot_attribution.__comment: Every bind param in a reference view MUST be a column of the derived row (S-136: with the catalogue any of its columns, without it the decision_key columns and aggregation names) -- the loader rejects anything else and drops just that view. A view that binds only PART of the decision key is legal but gets flagged scope_unresolved, because one confirmed value would then be stamped onto every member of the wider scope; both rules in this file bind the FULL key. | candidate_for is {target_field: view_result_column}. Without it declaring_views is empty, resolve_target_candidate refuses before running any SQL (enrichment/candidates.py:306-308), and the probe emits ZERO log lines -- which is indistinguishable from 'the feature is off'. That silent state is what this config exists to avoid. | INFERENCE #1 -- confirm which DT lot and slot a DT job's wafer ended up as. This cannot be done with a SQL join: bonding_log's (dt_lot, dt_slot) is the value AS OF BONDING and dt_log's is the value AS OF DT, and split/merge moved the wafer in between, so a naive join does not error -- it matches the wrong wafer plausibly. | auto_confirm is ON here but has nothing to confirm: the two views that named candidates (an equipment track-in event, a monotonic slot assignment) read lot_event columns the shipped table does not declare and went with the sample's on 10-28 (560c031cc); a single distinct answer is still the only thing that confirms, and anything else -- zero candidates, two candidates, a failed view -- stays in the queue for a human.

reference_views.label: 이 job의 원본 셀
reference_views.query: SELECT dt_eqp, product, dt_lot, dt_slot, dt_x, dt_y, core_wafer, core_lot, core_slot, c_bn, event_time FROM dt_log WHERE dt_job = :dt_job ORDER BY dt_y, dt_x

reference_views.label: 기록된 dt_lot/dt_slot (10%는 틀린 값이다)
reference_views.query: SELECT COALESCE(dt_lot, '') AS dt_lot, COALESCE(dt_slot, '') AS dt_slot, COUNT(*) AS cells FROM dt_log WHERE dt_job = :dt_job GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY cells DESC

reference_views.label: 앵커 - core_wafer가 적힌 셀
reference_views.query: SELECT core_wafer, core_lot, core_slot, COUNT(*) AS dies FROM dt_log WHERE dt_job = :dt_job AND COALESCE(core_wafer, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY dies DESC

core_frame_review.__comment: Manual visual review only. dt_core_view is a separate raw core-coordinate map namespace for each DT job; its source is deliberately not dt_log because dt_log/dt_job already owns the DT-frame wafer_map_metadata record. This rule proposes no automatic conclusion and must remain auto_confirm=false until core bin-fingerprint/topology evidence has an agreed acceptance policy.
